# ShohruxDigital

> Digital marketing, SEO and AI playbooks for Central Asia. Real campaigns, real numbers, by Shohruxbek Foziljonov.

ShohruxDigital is a multilingual (English, Uzbek, Russian) editorial journal covering digital marketing strategy, SEO, AI search optimization, paid media, and content systems — with a focus on Uzbekistan and Central Asian markets.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured editorial, latest posts and the newsletter.
- [Blog](/blog): All articles on marketing, SEO and AI.
- [Categories](/categories): Topic sections of the journal.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Real campaign breakdowns with numbers.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about digital marketing and SEO.
- [About](/about): About Shohruxbek Foziljonov and the journal.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [Subscribe](/subscribe): Weekly newsletter signup.
